Sobre a vaga

The Lead Engineer establishes the technical architecture and development standards for the project.

What You'll Do:

This role ensures that the team operates within a disciplined software development lifecycle and that engineering decisions align with long-term scalability and maintainability.

  • Defining application architecture
  • Establishing development patterns and standards
  • Guiding implementation decisions across the engineering team
  • Ensuring alignment with the organization's existing tooling and platform requirements

What We're Looking For:

  • TypeScript
  • Node.js
  • Next.js
  • React
  • modern CI/CD tooling
  • infrastructure as code (e.g., Pulumi)

What we offer:

  • Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Various benefits include flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

This job opening includes people registered in the National Registry for Persons with Disabilities (Registro Nacional de Personas con Discapacidad - Ley N° 19.691) who meet the conditions and suitability for the position. If you require any accommodations during the application process, please reach out to us at accessibility@qubika.com.

Qubika helps businesses evolve from digital-native to AI-native. With 20 years of experience, we’re shaping the future of next-generation applications by seamlessly integrating high-quality UX, robust security, and AI-driven intelligence. Our expertise spans the data and AI lifecycle - from data engineering and AI agent development to cloud integrations and human-centric product design. We drive AI transformations via three core pillars: -- AccelerateAI. Qubika’s comprehensive, secure-first framework of best practices, workflows, and methodologies to power engineering with AI. -- Agentic Factory. Industry-specific AI agents and solutions for financial services, health & life sciences, and high-tech. -- Data Foundation. End-to-end data services to build the strong data infrastructure needed for AI transformations. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we’re supported by multiple offices and delivery centers across the US and Latin America. In addition to our Gold Tier (Elite) Databricks partnership, we’re also an AWS Advanced Tier partner and Snowflake Select Tier partner. We’re SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and compliant with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Our expertise in AI and machine learning has been consistently recognized by the industry, including awards such as a top AI provider and top machine learning company from Clutch, a leading B2B research firm. Get in touch with our experts to learn more.
